# Good morning everyone. - 2026-09-27 14:58

**Date** 27 Sep 2026, 14:58 · **Duration** 2 min · **Captions** 17

_Processed entirely on-device: CPU_

## Topics

- eigenvalue
- eigenvector
- determinant
- diagonalize

## Key points

- These two ideas sit at the center of linear algebra, so it is worth going slowly.
- A matrix is a linear transformation. It stretches, rotates and cheers space.
- For most vectors, applying the matrix changes both direction and length.
- Those vectors are the eigenvectors, and the factor they stretch by is the eigenvalue.
- The determinant is a single number that tells you whether the matrix squashes space flat.
- If it is zero, there is a non-trivial solution, and that is exactly what we want.

## Follow up

None mentioned.

## Glossary

_Explanations in छत्तीसगढ़ी (Chhattisgarhi)._

- **eigenvalue** — A scalar showing how much a matrix stretches a special direction (its eigenvector).
- **eigenvector** — A direction that a matrix only stretches or shrinks, without rotating it.
- **determinant** — A single number from a square matrix; zero means the matrix squashes space flat.
- **diagonalize** — Rewriting a matrix in a basis where it becomes a simple diagonal scaling.

## Transcript

**[00:00]** Good morning everyone.
> सबो झन ल सुभ दिन।

**[00:02]** Today we will start with eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
> आज हम eigenvalues अउ eigenvectors ले शुरू करबो।

**[00:08]** These two ideas sit at the center of linear algebra, so it is worth going slowly.
> ये दुठन विचार रैखिक बीजगणित के केंद्र म बैठते हंवय, एखरबर एहर धीमा जाना लायक हवय।

**[00:15]** A matrix is a linear transformation. It stretches, rotates and cheers space.
> एक मैट्रिक्स एक रैखिक परिवर्तन हवय। ए खिंचाव, घूमता अउ अंतरिक्ष के आनंदित करत हवय।

**[00:24]** For most vectors, applying the matrix changes both direction and length.
> अधिकांश वेक्टर बर, मैट्रिक्स लागू करना दिशा अउ लंबाई दोनों ल बदलथे।

**[00:31]** But a few special vectors only change length.
> लेकिन कुछु विशेष वेक्टर केवल लंबाई ल बदलथें।

**[00:35]** Their direction is preserved.
> ओमनके दिशा संरक्षित हवय।

**[00:39]** Those vectors are the eigenvectors, and the factor they stretch by is the eigenvalue.
> ओ वेक्टर eigenvectors हवयं, अउ कारक जेहर ओमन द्वारा खिंचाव होत हवय eigenvalue हवय।

**[00:47]** To find them we solve the characteristic equation of the matrix.
> ओमनला खोजने बर हम मैट्रिक्स के विशिष्ट समीकरण ल हल करत हंवय ।

**[00:53]** The determinant of a minus lambda times the identity must equal zero.
> एक -लंबा बार पहचान के determinant शून्य के बराबर होना चाहि।

**[00:59]** The determinant is a single number that tells you whether the matrix squashes space flat.
> determinant एक एकल संख्या हवय जेहर बताता हवय कि मैट्रिक्स अंतरिक्ष सपाट करत हवय या नहीं।

**[01:07]** If it is zero, there is a non-trivial solution, and that is exactly what we want.
> यदि ए शून्य हवय, तो एक गैर-नाजुक समाधान हवय, अउ यही हम चाहत हंवय।

**[01:15]** Symmetric matrices always have real eigenvalues.
> सममित मैट्रिक्स म हमेशा वास्तविक eigenvalues होत हवय।

**[01:19]** That is a useful guarantee.
> ए एक उपयोगी गारंटी हवय।

**[01:23]** Once we have a full set of eigenvectors, we can diagonalize the matrix.
> एक बार जब हमन eigenvectors के पूरा सेट ल प्राप्त करथन, तो हम मैट्रिक्स ल diagonalize कर सकथन।

**[01:30]** Diagonalization turns a hard repeated multiplication into a simple one.
> Diagonalization एक कठिन दोहराए गए गुणा ल एक सरल म बदल देत हवय।

**[01:37]** We will use this next week when we look at principal component analysis.
> हम आने सप्ताह के उपयोग करत हंवय जब हम मुख्य घटक विश्लेषण ल देखेंगे।
